svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 11 — "The Glyph Discovery" — Section 2 Most Important Narrative Plant
svg.desc: Page 11: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full / half-half / full). Theodore enters the basement holding Luma in his palm like a living lantern. Scanner cone reveals interior claw marks (residue 10× outside — this is a LAIR). Theodore's face is under-lit by Luma's scanner — alien blue-violet on familiar boy. THE DISCOVERY: a fairy glyph carved at human reach height (~5 feet), simplified for non-fairy comprehension, decades old. Below it: a human English response, scratched cruder, partially worn — proof of prior contact, prior partnership.
